verdict.rationale: The product's own documented features run automatically in the background on incoming mail: automatic AI labeling and summaries, plus junk filtering. Integrations are described as keeping documents and mail in sync. There is no evidence of user-defined automation rules, triggers or schedules, and the API mentions are developer building blocks rather than a configurable automation feature. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules or workflows, documented triggers/actions, recurring or scheduled automation, documented autonomous agent behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Get instant AI summaries and automatic labels that help you stay on top of your mail, save time, and keep your inbox organized.
AI summaries and categorization that help you save time and stay organized
Use APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use, so your documents and mail stay in sync and your work keeps moving.
